found.finding: A morning report still failed after the three hourly tries was never kept for 4 pm: the last hourly re-check runs with no run name, so the keep line (which needed the morning run) never fired. The test that passed had preset 'tries 3' by hand. Fixed: the retry record carries the run the report first failed in and the keep line reads it; the tests now walk the real road (morning failure, then three unnamed hourly re-check runs) and fail without the fix.

A report kept after a morning sign-in wall that then fails again after Resume can be on both the hourly list and the 4 pm list and be fetched twice; the Flipkart 20 still holds (also true in 0.1.44). Left.
Only 'landed' takes a report off the 4 pm list; a later 'nothing to fetch' leaves it there for one harmless extra walk. Left.

The restored lines are word for word the 0.1.44 ones; the 4 pm run goes through the same start as every run (capped at what is left of the day's 20); landed reports come off the list; a stale day and unknown ids are not taken; own-time runs do not touch the list.
A Flipkart orders or payments report that failed before its ask was placed is not retried hourly and, in a morning run, is kept by this list for the 4 pm run (shown by a trial).
